description: Defines the DistAutogradContainer class responsible for managing distributed autograd contexts, message IDs, and related synchronization in a multi-threaded, distributed setting within PyTorch's autograd system.

classes.name: DistAutogradContainer
classes.description: Singleton class managing distributed autograd contexts, message IDs, and cleanup operations across workers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: One-time initialization of the container with worker ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieve the singleton instance of the container.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Create a new autograd context for a distributed pass.

methods.name: releaseContext
methods.description: Clean up resources for a specific context ID and notify other workers.

methods.name: releaseContextIfPresent
methods.description: Release a context if it exists on this node.

methods.name: isValidContext
methods.description: Check if a context ID is valid.

methods.name: retrieveContext
methods.description: Get the autograd context for a given ID.

methods.name: currentContext
methods.description: Get the current thread's active autograd context.

methods.name: hasValidContext
methods.description: Check if the current thread has a valid autograd context.

methods.name: newAutogradMessageId
methods.description: Generate a new unique message ID for autograd send/recv operations.

methods.name: getOrCreateContext
methods.description: Retrieve or create a context with a specific ID.

methods.name: getMaxId
methods.description: Get the maximum possible autograd context or message ID.

methods.name: getWorkerId
methods.description: Get the worker ID for this node.

methods.name: setCurrentContextId
methods.description: Set the current context ID for the thread if none is set.

methods.name: forceCurrentContextId
methods.description: Forcefully override the thread's current context ID.

methods.name: clearCurrentContext
methods.description: Clear the thread's current context ID.

methods.name: numAutogradContexts
methods.description: Return the number of autograd contexts stored.

methods.name: currentContextId
methods.description: Get the thread-local current context ID.
